source.name: FrontierHarness Eval v1.1 leaderboard (frontierharness.org) / frontier-harness-eval/eval release/v1.1
source.metric: pass rate % = verifier passes / scored attempts (62 tasks x 4 attempts per harness-model cell = 248; 1,240 per harness pooled over 5 models). Infra errors excluded; timeouts graded; reward-hacking/online-solution-lookup passes counted as fails. cost_per_task_usd = mean over tasks of each task's mean inference cost (Baseten list price x reported tokens), i.e. the site's 'average cost per task'; cost_per_pass_usd = cost_per_task / pass_rate.
source.notes: Repo contains no per-trial results files (only README table with pooled pass rate + cost per pass, suite config, dataset manifest). Per-model numbers were recomputed from the site's public trial feed (/api/live, 27,280 trials, complete=true) using the site's own scoring code (js/live.js); pooled pass rates and cost per pass reproduce the README table exactly (e.g. ZCode 61.9% $1.06/pass, Codex CLI 61.1% $0.937/pass). All runs at effort max via Baseten; run window 2026-11-10..2026-11-14 (date field = run end). Models: GLM-5.3, GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, Muse Spark Open, Kimi-K3. No stderr published. Harness versions included. Dataset frontier-harness-eval/frontier-harness-eval@v1.1.0 (45 TB2.1-derived + 17 'tb4' tasks).

source.notes: 142 rows total; included top 30 by rank, plus the best row for every other distinct agent, plus Terminus 2 rows for open-weight models (GLM/Kimi/DeepSeek/MiniMax/Qwen). stderr here is derived as ci95_half_width/1.96 (only the CI is published); null where no CI published.
